hypothesis.statement: move_logic22's last residual is ONE displaced load and it is an initializer-EMISSION-ORDER question, not a register one. Target emits the address before the float constant -- `@0x164 addi r4,r3,0 @sMilestones(ADDR16_LO)` then `@0x168 lfs f7,0(0) @lbl_803468B0(EMB_SDA21)` -- while ours emits them swapped, `@0x164 lfs f7,0(0) @lbl_803468B0(EMB_SDA21)` then `@0x168 addi r3,r3,0 @sMilestones(ADDR16_LO)`. Per claim.law.SB_declaration-order-is-double-bound MWCC emits initializer loads in DECLARATION order, and `f32 best_dist = lbl_803468B0;` is the only initializer in the block ahead of the loop. The untried form is to make best_dist statement-bound and place its assignment AFTER the for-init, so the address materialises first; the two forms that move the ADDRESS into an initializer instead were both measured NEUTRAL-IDENTICAL here and must not be re-run.
